^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^7^x70FF70Level 1-20 (By 20 You're Running ^x7070FFRF)^7 ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^5Preparing the RF Swap. Make sure to Read If you're New^7
You can expect to start running ^x8888FFRighteous Fire^7 in Act II. ^7Once you kill "^xFFFF77Fidelitas, the Mourning^7" in "^xFFFF77The Chamber of Sins Level 2^7", and turn in the quest, "^xAF6025Intruders in Black^7", you will be able to purchase a ^x7070FFRighteous Fire^7 Gem from Yeena in "The Forest Encampment"
You want to make sure you do the ^xB97123Ruby Ring^7 Recipe (^xC8C8C8Iron Ring ^7+ ^xE05030Red Gem^7): Open a NPC Vendor and place your^xC8C8C8 Iron Ring^7 +^xE05030 Red Gem^7 (any red gem) and they will offer you a ^xB97123Ruby Ring^7 in return, do this Twice to guarantee 2x ^xB97123Ruby Rings^7
If you didn't find any ^xC8C8C8Iron Rings ^7on the Filter, you can always go to the shops and check, you can even go back to Act 1
From this point you want to Craft "^xB97123Fire Resistance^7" On every piece that has an open Suffix. Simply place it in the Crafting Bench and Craft ^xB97123Fire Resistance^7 for 1 ^x8888FFTransmute^7, the more the better
You want a minimum of ^xB97123120 Fire Res^7, the more the better as you combine this with the ^xB97123Fire Resistance^7 Mastery "^xB97123Regenerate 1 Life Per second per uncapped fire resistance^7" This means the number in the " "
You also have the option of grabbing a herald here, I like ^x8888FFHerald of Thunder^7 because it boosts your ^x8888FF^x7070FFRolling Magma^7^7 damage quite a bit
This is also a good time to swap to a shield and start ^xE05030Shield Charging^7 if you want to speed up your campaign
^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^7^x70FF70Level 21-40 & Bandits^7 ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^7For Bandits I like to Help Kraityn For the ^x70FF70Movement Speed^7, You can also kill all for a skill point.
At the start of Act III After killing Piety the first time, You're going to get access to a new set of Auras & Curses. I like to take "^x8888FFPurity of Elements^7" Which helps resistance Cap you & Provide Ailment Immunity Make sure you're not linking any of your Auras to support gems. Usually by this point I'm running ^x8888FFPurity of Elements^7 + ^xE05030Vitality^7 OR ^x8888FFHerald of Thunder^7
You're also going to be rewarded the "^x8888FFFlammability^7" Gem. You're going to want to take this and support it with "^xE05030Lifetap^7" This will make your curse spend Life Instead of Mana. When you do this you can get rid of ^x8888FFFlame Wall^7
After Killing Piety the Second time, I usually make my way over to "^xFFFF77Library^7" This is mandatory to complete so you can get support gems for your ^x8888FFRighteous Fire^7 & Also so you can purchase your new single target "^x70FF70Fire Trap^7" You won't be able to use this skill right away. So make sure to put it in your weapon swap and purchase a weapon with a ^x70FF70green socket^7 so it can level on the side. Down below is a list of gems to purchase from Library
^x70FF70Fire Trap^7, ^x8888FFEfficacy, Elemental Focus^7, ^x70FF70Swift Affliction^7, ^x70FF70Trap & Mine Damage^7, ^xE05030Burning Damage^7 (You can also purchase ^x8888FFArmageddon Brand^7 if you want to replace rolling magma) There are a few more gems to purchase, you can find them in the "Skills Section" But this will be the most important for right now
At this point you're going to want to Gamble for a 4-Link piece for your ^x8888FFRighteous Fire^7. (Assuming you don't have one already) What I like to do is look at my Helmet or Gloves, and gamble the worst piece. I like to Gamble ^xB97123Armour^7+^x8888FFEnergy Shield^7 Hybrid because it's much easier to roll the Desired Colors: Which are ^x8888FF3 Blue^7 ^xE050301 Red^7 for your ^x8888FFRighteous Fire^7. Gambling has a nice chance for the gear to already be Pre 4-Linked. There is an NPC in each act who will allow your to spend your Gold on Gambling
Upon completing the first Quest in Act 4 You'll be rewarded a Golem. I recommend^xE05030 Stone Golem^7 because he gives Increased ^xE05030Defenses^7 + ^xE05030Life Regen^7
If you want to go a bit faster and do more damage, consider purchasing "^x70FF70Blood Rage^7" This will add an additional Degen to your character but Provide ^x70FF70Frenzy Charges^7 on Kill
^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^x70FF70Level 41-60 Swapping to Fire Trap^7 ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^7At around level 40 I usually swap out ^x8888FFRolling Magma^7 or ^x8888FFArma Brand^7 for ^x70FF70Fire Trap^7. We gamble for our 4-Link and I like to purchase ^xB97123Armour^7+^x70FF70Evasion^7. This is for the same reason listed as before, we want ^x70FF702 Green ^7^x8888FF1 Blue^7 ^xE050301 Red^7 Later on when taking ^xB97123Ramako Sun's Light ^xADAA47Ascendancy ^7we switch to ^x70FF703 Green^7 ^xE050301 Red^7
If you're lacking ^x70FF70Dexterity^7 for ^x70FF70Fire Trap^7, you can purchase a ^x8888FFTurquoise^x70FF70 Amulet^7, You can also Allocate a ^x70FF70+30 Dexterity^7 node by Acrimony, You're also able to craft "^x70FF70Dexterity^7" as a suffix on gear
After Killing the bosses Daresso & Kaom, and turning in the quest, you'll gain a new support gem "^x8888FFIncreased Area of effect^7". I like to replace ^x8888FFEfficacy^7 in ^x8888FFRF^7 for ^x8888FFIncreased^7 ^x8888FFArea of Effect^7
After Going to Chamber of Sins & killing Maligaro in his instance you will be able to access the Final Trial for ^xFFFF77Cruel Lab^7. After Ascending you will have 2 Choices. You can either go for "^xB97123Ramako, Sun's Light^7" OR "^xB97123Hinekora, Death's Fury^7" I prefer ^xB97123Hinekora^7 for clear speed but ^xAF6025^xB97123Ramako^7^7 provides a lot more damage
If going ^xB97123Ramako^7 Swap out "^x8888FFCombustion Support^7" for "^x70FF70Swift Affliction^7" You're going to need to change the socket color from ^x8888FFBlue^7 to ^x70FF70Green^7
If going ^xB97123Ramako^7 Swap your curse from "^x8888FFFlammability^7" To "^xE05030Punishment^7" Change socket color from^x8888FF Blue^7 to ^xE05030Red^7
This is because with ^xB97123Ramako, Sun's Light^7 you no longer benefit from Minus Resistance such as ^x8888FFFlammability^7
If you chose ^xB97123Hinekora, Death's Fury^7 You will make the above changes when you allocate ^xB97123Ramako^7 after Finishing ^xADAA47Merciless Labrynth^7 (Around level 65)
^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^x70FF70Level 61-90 ^1Starting Maps^7 & ^xFFFF77Pantheon ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^7After Finishing the Campaign make sure to type /Passives and make sure you have all your additional skills points
Before I start mapping I like to look at my gear and gamble for upgrades. (Do not gamble weapon/Accessories it's a waste of gold IMO)
I focus on Gloves/Helmet/Boots/Body. Your primary focus here is to get ^xE05030High Life^7 with ^xB97123Fire Resistance^7, ^xD02090Chaos Resistance^7 or ^xE05030Life Regen Rate^7 which is a ^xADAA47MULTIPLIER^7^7 to your FLAT ^xE05030Life Regen^7 that you scale with the ^xB97123Fire Mastery^7
This is around the time when you stop stacking ^xB97123Fire resistance^7 and focus on other affixes. Such as:^7 ^xE05030^7 ^xE05030Life^7^7, ^xD02090Chaos Resistance^7, ^x70FF70Dexterity^7, ^xE05030Life Regeneration Rate^7, ^xE05030BIG Flat Life Regen^7
Note: It's still important to have ^xB97123High Fire Resistance^7 since we're capping our^x8888FF Cold^7 & ^xADAA47Lightning Resistance^7 Via ^xB97123Fire Resistance^7 due to ^xB97123Tasalio^7, ^xB97123Cleansing Waters^7 (our ascendancy)
You can also look at some of the gear in the POB Gear Section under this loadout to see examples
Starting Maps I like to start using ^xE05030Enduring Cry^7 for ^xE05030Endurance Charge Generation^7, we will passively generate ^xE05030Endurance Charges^7 later on with an^xADAA47 Amulet Annoint^7 ^xB97123Endurance Charges^7^7^7 ^7make you take less ^x8888FFEle Damage^7 & ^xC8C8C8Physical damage^7 while provide you more ^xE05030Life Regen^7 because you take less damage from ^x8888FFRF^7
Also make sure you have selected your ^xADAA47^xFFFF77Pantheon^7^7. You want to be running^xADAA47 Brine King^7 + ^xADAA47Ralakesh^7
After finding my first ^x70FF70labyrinth trial^7 (In ^xFFFF77Yellow Maps^7) and completing it you will gain a ^x8888FFOffering to the Goddess^7. After completing your^xFFFF77 Uber Lab^7 you're going to want to purchase a ^xADAA47Divine Vessel^7 (if you haven't already found one)
Search on the Atlas "^xADAA47Brine King^7" You're going to want to run the map that states "^xADAA47^x8888FF100% Chance to avoid being frozen^7^7" Put the ^xADAA47Divine vessel^7 along with this map in the device, run it and consume the vessel to unlock your ^x8888FFFreeze Avoidance^7
After finishing the ^xFFFF77Panthon^7 + ^xFFFF77Uber Lab^7 you may now Swap your Auras. I Swap to:
^x70FF70^x8888FFSkitter Bot^7^7 + ^x8888FFUnbound Ailments^7 ^x8888FFTempest Shield^7 ^xE05030Flesh and Stone^7 (Only in Sand Stance) ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7
This is also a great time to snag an^xAF6025 Immortal Flesh Belt^7 &^xAF6025 Rise of the Phoenix^7^7 to help push you to 90% Max All Resistance
^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^x70FF70Around Level 90^7 Going Block Based^7, ^xB97123Getting Ignite Proliferation ^7& ^xE05030Setting up 6 Life Mastery^7 ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^xADAA47Going Block Based^7 allows you to survive while being Surrounded or Taking a barrage of hits. This complements very well with lower damage builds that end up soaking a lot of damage. This is also the time when I like to purchase a ^xAF6025Cloak of Flame^7. To help manage big ^xC8C8C8Physical Hits^7
To make this swap you're going to want to find or Purchase a "^x8888FFShaper Shield^7" I prefer having an ^xB97123Armour shield^7. The more the better but don't spend too much on it. Some good examples would be. ^xB97123Pinnacle Tower Shield^7, ^xB97123Ezomyte Tower Shield^7, ^xB97123Colossal Tower Shield^7
To craft this shield you can refer to the crafting tab on the top of my website. In Trade League I like to use ^xE05030Pristine Life Fossils^7 or ^x8888FFHarvest^7 ^xE05030Reforge Life^7 although I prefer Fossils. You're going to do this till you hit ^xE05030Recover 3-5% Life on Block^7
We will respec part of our Tree to take the block nodes shown along with the Keystone "^xADAA47Glancing Blows^7" This will get us ^x70FF7075% Block^7 & ^x70FF70Spell Block^7
^xB97123Ignite Proliferation^7 is a Modifier you can find by using "^xB97123Exarch Embers^7" on your gloves. It's a ^xD020901/50^7 Chance to roll and elevates your clear to the next level. Your ^xB97123Hinekora Explosion^7 has the ability to ^xB97123Ignite^7 which works off your ^xB97123Global Ignite^7 Chance, you can find this in the character sheet under Default Attack You either want to use the above stat mentioned or go down the Cluster Jewel route via "^xB97123Fan the Flames^7" which I have removed from this PoB due to players getting Confused
^xE050306 Life Mastery Setup^7 - This combined with the^xE05030 Life on Block ^7Shield^7 should make your character Insanely tanky. It makes it very easy to hit values like ^xE050307k+ Life^7 even on a budget. You want to take them all at the same time since a lot of the masteries don't really provide any benefit. Make sure to read them!
^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^x70FF70HELP I DON'T HAVE ENOUGH MANA TO RUN ALL THE AURAS^7 ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^xC8C8C8Here are some common Problems:^7^7
Don't link your auras to ^xE05030Lifetap^7 or other support gems unless stated in the POB such as ^x8888FFSkitterbot^7 with ^x8888FFUnbound Ailments^7
Make SURE To take ALL The ^x7070FFReservation Nodes^7 that the POB Takes. Take a second Glance then a third then allow your friends to look as well
Make SURE to use the ^xADAA47Loadout ^7Feature in the ^xADAA47Top right of PoB ^7so that you are navigating correctly
Pay attention to the gear, Sometimes such as in the "^x8888FFMalevolence^7" Loadout, you will use a shield with ^xADAA47Gem Reservation^7
In this instance FOLLOW the Skills Section to know what Gems go WHERE. We also use a Cluster Jewel in this Loadout which reduces ^x8888FFMalevolence^7 Mana Reservation
^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^x70FF70Additional Information^7 ^xFFFF77~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
^7For Early mapping I usually put ^x8888FFRF^7 in my Gloves/Boots/Helm so I can use a ^xE05030PURE Armour Body^7 till I go ^xAF6025Cloak of Flame^7. This is because trying to off color a pure Armour can be difficult in the early stages. If you have an early ^xAF6025Cloak of Flame^7 or a 5/6L you can just ignore this
^xAF6025What Bandits do I help/Kill^7^xAF6025? ^7Helping Kraityn is what I'll do for ^x70FF708% Movement Speed^7 Helping Oak is advisable for newer players for ^xE0503040 Bonus life^7 Killing all Bandits is the best option for Single target since it offers you a ^xADAA47Skill Point^7
^xB97123What auras to use in Campaign?^7 In the very early acts we'll be using ^xE05030Vitality^7, Later in Act 3 We'll gain Access to ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 & ^xE05030Determination^7. Use the ^x8888FFPurity of Elements^7 and hold the ^xE05030Determ^7 till once you pickup the Auras Reservation nodes After securing ^xADAA47Freeze Immunity^7 on the Panthon we'll drop ^x8888FFPurity of Elements^7 in Favor of ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7 & ^x8888FFSkitterbots^7.
^xB97123What jewels to I look for?^7 Rare Jewels usually end up being expensive, remember you can look for many different combinations. I'll list some usable stats you can mix and match to save currency: ^xB97123 Prefix^7 Life, Fire Damage ^xB97123Suffix^7 Increased Damage, Fire damage over time multiplier, damage over time multiplier, area damage, burning damage, chaos resistance, dexterity
^xB97123Which Large Cluster Jewels^7 ^xB97123to use?^7 Anything with Prismatic heart or Burning bright in the front. You can also opt out for 12 Passive clusters and try to craft them for stats like + Life & Chaos Res with Increased effect
^xB97123Which Medium Cluster Jewels^7 ^xAF6025to use?^7 Flow of life + Any combination
As a reminder, Golems usually start to fall off in Yellow maps, they will repeatedly die as you get into higher content, I suspect a similar fate to the Animate Guardian
